tools.name: smsmode_get_balance
tools.description: The credit balance of the connected smsmode account (and sub-organisations an administrator key can see): amount and currency (negative = owed on a POST_PAY account), payment type (PRE_PAY / POST_PAY), state, monthly consumption and its limit. Good first call; check it before sending SMS. GET /commo

tools.name: smsmode_get_organisation
tools.description: Full details of one organisation: contacts, addresses, company information, balance, monthly limit and consumption. GET /commons/v1/organisations/{id}.

tools.name: smsmode_list_channels
tools.description: List messaging channels (SMS or RCS; flow TRANSACTIONAL / MARKETING / OTP) with default sender, daily and monthly limits and consumption. A channel id is needed to scope messages or consumption to one channel. GET /commons/v1/channels.

tools.name: smsmode_get_channel
tools.description: Details of one channel: type, flow, default sender ID and authorized sender IDs, limits and consumption. GET /commons/v1/channels/{id}.

tools.name: smsmode_list_consumptions
tools.description: Sent-message counts and money spent per month or per day (price amount and currency), optionally for one channel. Default: monthly, the last 3 months. GET /commons/v1/consumptions.

tools.name: smsmode_get_consumption
tools.description: One consumption record broken down by country (mcc) or network (mccMnc) with quantity and price per sub-item, optionally with delivery statuses. GET /commons/v1/consumptions/{id}.

tools.name: smsmode_lookup_number
tools.description: Country and mobile network (mcc/mnc, operator) of a phone number. Only for customers with a premium smsmode subscription and, for now, only French numbers (403 otherwise). GET /commons/v1/lookup/{msisdn}.

tools.name: smsmode_list_messages
tools.description: Messages with delivery status (SCHEDULED, ENROUTE, DELIVERED, UNDELIVERABLE, UNDELIVERED; status.detail names the cause), recipient, sender, text, parts and price. Default window: the last 10 days. Filter by direction (MT = sent, MO = replies received), recipient, your reference, channel or campaign

tools.name: smsmode_get_message
tools.description: One message: delivery status and detail, delivery date, recipient network, text, parts and price. GET /sms/v1/messages/{id}.

tools.name: smsmode_list_campaigns
tools.description: Existing SMS campaigns (grouped sends) with status SCHEDULED / ONGOING / ENDED, quantity, price and per-status delivery counts. Read only: this server does not send campaigns. GET /sms/v1/campaigns.

tools.name: smsmode_get_campaign
tools.description: One campaign: state, period, recipients count, text, price and delivery counts per status. Use smsmode_list_messages with campaign_id for its individual messages. GET /sms/v1/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: smsmode_send_sms
tools.description: WRITE, SPENDS CREDIT: sends one SMS text to 1 to 10 recipients (one message each, a batch of unit messages) and texts REAL people immediately, or at send_at. Cost: every message is charged to the account at its destination's price per SMS part (GSM7: 160 characters for 1 part, 306 for 2, 459 for 3..

tools.name: smsmode_cancel_scheduled_message
tools.description: WRITE: cancels ONE message that is still scheduled (status SCHEDULED, sent with send_at) so it is not sent; smsmode refuses messages already sent. Cannot be undone. DELETE /sms/v1/messages/{id}.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "smsmode_send_sms" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smsmode_list_channels, smsmode_list_consumptions, smsmode_list_messages, smsmode_get_message, smsmode_get_campaign, smsmode_send_sms · Private data: smsmode_get_organisation, smsmode_get_consumption · Public sink: smsmode_get_balance, smsmode_list_channels, smsmode_list_messages, smsmode_get_message, smsmode_list_campaigns, smsmode_get_campaign, smsmode_send_sms, smsmode_cancel_scheduled_message · Destructive: smsmode_cancel_scheduled_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smsmode_list_channels, smsmode_list_consumptions, smsmode_list_messages, smsmode_get_message, smsmode_get_campaign, smsmode_send_sms · Private data: smsmode_get_organisation, smsmode_get_consumption · Public sink: smsmode_get_balance, smsmode_list_channels, smsmode_list_messages, smsmode_get_message, smsmode_list_campaigns, smsmode_get_campaign, smsmode_send_sms, smsmode_cancel_scheduled_message · Destructive: smsmode_cancel_scheduled_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
